subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should chat `/status` and `session_status` share a configurable visibility policy, and what must each surface return when the rendered card is disabled?
rationale: The request adds persistent configuration and changes a shared user/tool response contract; the repository policy requires maintainer intent before expanding config surface or altering existing defaults.

options.title: Define one shared visibility contract
options.body: Preserve the current card by default and specify whether disabled mode yields structured data, reduced text, or no visible reply for both chat and tool callers.

options.title: Keep the current status-card contract
options.body: Decline a new visibility setting if the status output is intentionally always available and the existing separate CLI JSON diagnostics surface is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Define one shared visibility contract
recommendation.body: Preserve the current card by default and specify whether disabled mode yields structured data, reduced text, or no visible reply for both chat and tool callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and supplied history connect steipete to the canonical-tracker decision and the shared status-path refactor.
